subject_names.span: The Gabelli Utility Trust (the “Fund,” “we,” “us” or “our”) is issuing subscription rights (the “Rights”) to our common shareholders

subject_tickers.span: Common Shares are listed on the New York Stock Exchange (“NYSE”) under the symbol “GUT.”

security_class.span: is issuing subscription rights (the “Rights”) to our common shareholders to purchase additional common shares

rights_per_share.span: One Right will be issued in respect of each Common Share of the Fund outstanding as of the close of business on the Record Date.

rights_per_new_share.span: Seven Rights will be required to purchase one Common Share.

price_reference.span: Seven Rights may be exercised at a price of $5.50 per Common Share (the “Subscription Price”).

record_date.span: Rights will be issued to holders of record of the Fund’s Common Shares as of the close business on March 11, 2021 (the “Record Date”).

expiration_date.span: which will be 5:00 PM Eastern Time on April 14, 2021 (the “Expiration Date”), unless otherwise extended.

over_subscription.span: An over-subscription privilege will be offered, subject to the right of the Board of Trustees of the Fund (the “Board”) to eliminate the over-subscription privilege.

max_new_shares.span: 7,885,840 Common Shares of the Fund will be issued if all Rights are exercised.

notes: Fixed subscription price of $5.50 per Common Share (not a percent of NAV or market), so price_pct and price_floor_pct_nav are null. Record date conflict: the summary and the Important Dates table state March 11, 2021, but the Description of the Rights Offering says 'as of the close of business on March 11, 2020 (the “Record Date”'; 2021 used (the 2020 looks like a typo; prospectus supplement dated March 11, 2021). Expiration April 14, 2021 'unless otherwise extended'; no extension stated. Rights listed on NYSE as 'GUT RT'. 55,200,877 Rights for 7,885,840 Common Shares; no secondary over-allotment stated. The Board may eliminate the over-subscription privilege.
